Anonymous, The Pearl, edited by Sophie Jewett.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/anonymous/the-pearl/sophie-jewett

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Anonymous, the author: no death year, because the work is anonymous.
- Sophie Jewett, the editor, annotator and writer of the introduction or preface, died 1909 (Wikidata Q52155684, P570 1909-01-01).

First publication of the text used: The colophon gives no publication year for this edition. The text was written between 1360 and 1400. (SE colophon: 'The Pearl was written between 1360 and 1400.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the colophon gives no publication year for this edition, so the United States side rests on the edition's rights statement quoted below, which says the text is in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin: Every person whose words are in the text died in 1925 or earlier (Sophie Jewett, the editor, died 1909), so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less. The country of first publication does not matter. The original is an anonymous work written between 1360 and 1400, before 1800, so it is public domain in every country whatever its country of origin.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
